* ci(ios): identify the compiler by content for ccache

ccache's default compiler check is the compiler's mtime, which differs
between runner image versions for the same Xcode 16.4: a #696 run on a
newer image restored master's cache and got 0/505 hits (504/505 on the
previous image).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* DO NOT MERGE: save ccache from this branch to measure a warm build

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(ios): version the ccache key

An exact cache hit skips the save, so with an unchanged lockfile master
would keep restoring the entry built with the mtime compiler check and
never store content-checked entries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* DO NOT MERGE: re-run to measure the warm ccache build

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(ios): launch the app once before Detox

With a cached build Detox starts minutes after the simulator booted; on
one run its first two launchApp calls hung past the 300 s hook timeout
(failing two suites) while the third took ~1.5 min. A first launch from
simctl takes that hit outside Detox.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

ci(ios): identify the compiler by content for ccache (#755)

* ci(ios): identify the compiler by content for ccache

ccache's default compiler check is the compiler's mtime, which differs
between runner image versions for the same Xcode 16.4: a #696 run on a
newer image restored master's cache and got 0/505 hits (504/505 on the
previous image).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* DO NOT MERGE: save ccache from this branch to measure a warm build

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(ios): version the ccache key

An exact cache hit skips the save, so with an unchanged lockfile master
would keep restoring the entry built with the mtime compiler check and
never store content-checked entries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* DO NOT MERGE: re-run to measure the warm ccache build

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci(ios): launch the app once before Detox

With a cached build Detox starts minutes after the simulator booted; on
one run its first two launchApp calls hung past the 300 s hook timeout
(failing two suites) while the third took ~1.5 min. A first launch from
simctl takes that hit outside Detox.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
